```{r}
                                 age_years > 60  ~ ">60",
                                 TRUE ~ NA), 
         year = lubridate::year(clean_date_of_notification),
         year_period = case_when(str_detect(year, "2007|2008|2009") ~ "2007-2009",
                                 str_detect(year, "2010|2011|2012|2013|2014") ~ "2010-2014",
                                 str_detect(year, "2015|2016|2017|2018") ~ "2015-2018",
                                 str_detect(year, "2019|2020|2021|2022|2023") ~ "2019-2023",
                                 TRUE ~ NA),
         race_2 = case_when(race == 1 ~ "White",
                            race == 2 ~ "Afro-descendants",
                            race == 3 ~ "Yellow",
                            race == 4 ~ "Brown",
                            race == 5 ~ "Indigenous",
                            race == 9 ~ "Unknown",
                            TRUE ~ NA),
         region = case_when(
             federative_unit %in% c(11, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17) ~ "North",

             federative_unit %in% c(41, 42, 43)             ~ "South",
             federative_unit %in% c(50, 51, 52, 53)         ~ "Center-West",
             TRUE                                           ~ NA_character_),
         age_group_3 = factor(age_group_3, levels = c("0-1", "1-2", "2-3", "3-5", "5-15",
                                                      "15-20", "20-40", "40-60",
                                                      ">60")),
         education_level = factor(education_level, levels = c("Incomplete elementary school",
                                                              "Complete elementary and incomplete middle school",
                                                              "Complete middle school and incomplete high school",
                                                              "Complete high school",
                                                              "Incomplete university",
                                                              "Complete university",
                                                              "N/A")),
         age_group_2 = factor(age_group_2, levels = c("0-1", "1-5", "6-15", "16-50", ">50")),
         fever_2 = case_when(fever == 1 ~ "Yes",
                             fever == 2 ~ "No",
                             fever == 9 ~ "Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ NA),
         edema_2 = case_when(edema == 1 ~ "Yes",
                             edema == 2 ~ "No",
                             edema == 9 ~ "Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ NA),
         hemorrhagic_phenomena_2 = case_when(hemorrhagic_phenomena == 1 ~ "Yes",
                             hemorrhagic_phenomena == 2 ~ "No",
                             hemorrhagic_phenomena == 9 ~ "Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ NA),
         hiv_2 = case_when(hiv == 1 ~ "Yes",
                             hiv == 2 ~ "No",
                             hiv == 9 ~ "Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ NA),
         fever_2 = factor(fever_2, levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")),
         edema_2 = factor(edema_2, levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")),
         hemorrhagic_phenomena_2 = factor(hemorrhagic_phenomena_2, levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")),
         name_tx = case_when(
             type_of_rx == 1 ~ "Antimonial Pentavalent",
             type_of_rx == 2 ~ "Amphotericin B deoxycholate",
             type_of_rx == 3 ~ "Others",                     ### Pentamidine - Others
             type_of_rx == 4 ~ "Liposomal amphotericin B",
             type_of_rx == 5 ~ "Others",
             type_of_rx == 6 ~ NA_character_,                # Nothing - NA (excluded)??
             TRUE ~ NA_character_))
```

### Table 1. Baseline characteristics based on median time and range of delay symptom onset to diagnosis, diagnosis to treatment initiation and overall (symptom onset to treatment initation)

```{r}
### Distribution and direction time between recurrences by characteristics and some variables chosen 
### variables in the table
var_order <- c("age_group_2", "gender", "year_period", "region",
               "education_level", "race_2", "hiv_2", "evolution")

### desired level orders WITH the reference (or desired) first
level_orders <- list(
  age_group_2 = c("0-1", "1-5", "6-15", "16-50", ">50"),
  gender      = c("Female", "Male"),
  year_period = c("2007-2009", "2010-2014", "2015-2018", "2019-2023"),
  region      = c("Center-West", "North", "Northeast", "Southeast", "South"),
  education_level = c(
    "Incomplete elementary school",
    "Complete elementary and incomplete middle school",
    "Complete middle school and incomplete high school",
    "Complete high school",
    "Incomplete university",
    "Complete university",
    "N/A"
  ),
  race_2 = c("Brown", "White", "Afro-descendants", "Yellow", "Indigenous", "Unknown"),
  hiv_2  = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"),
  evolution = c("Cure", "Death for VL", "Death for any-cause", "Neglect", "Transferred", NA)
)

### Function to make baseline table by delay variables
median_time_order <- function(vars, level_orders = list(), data = data_6) {
  map_dfr(vars, function(v) {
    
    # subset: valid characteristic and non-missing ts-tt delay > 0
    d_sub <- data %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[v]]),
             !is.na(dif_day_tx_symp),
             dif_day_tx_symp > 0)
    
    if (nrow(d_sub) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # enforce factor levels according to level_orders (this sets display/reference)
    if (!is.null(level_orders[[v]])) {
      d_sub[[v]] <- factor(d_sub[[v]], levels = level_orders[[v]])
    } else {
      d_sub[[v]] <- factor(d_sub[[v]])
    }
    
    # denominator for n/N (here: all rows in data_6, as you had it)
    denom <- nrow(d_sub)
    
    # summary: n/N, medians [IQR] and ranges for 3 time intervals
    df_sum <- d_sub %>%
      group_by(.data[[v]]) %>%
      summarise(
    n = paste0(
      scales::comma(n(),    big.mark = ","), "/", 
      scales::comma(denom, big.mark = ",")
    ),
        
        median_1 = paste0(
          round(median(dif_day_dx_symp, na.rm = TRUE), 0), " [",
          round(quantile(dif_day_dx_symp, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "-",
          round(quantile(dif_day_dx_symp, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "]"
        ),
        range_1 = paste0(
          min(dif_day_dx_symp, na.rm = TRUE), "-",
          max(dif_day_dx_symp, na.rm = TRUE)
        ),
        
        median_2 = paste0(
          round(median(dif_day_tx_dx, na.rm = TRUE), 0), " [",
          round(quantile(dif_day_tx_dx, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "-",
          round(quantile(dif_day_tx_dx, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "]"
        ),
        range_2 = paste0(
          min(dif_day_tx_dx, na.rm = TRUE), "-",
          max(dif_day_tx_dx, na.rm = TRUE)
        ),
        
        median_3 = paste0(
          round(median(dif_day_tx_symp, na.rm = TRUE), 0), " [",
          round(quantile(dif_day_tx_symp, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "-",
          round(quantile(dif_day_tx_symp, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "]"
        ),
        range_3 = paste0(
          min(dif_day_tx_symp, na.rm = TRUE), "-",
          max(dif_day_tx_symp, na.rm = TRUE)
        ),
        
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        variable = v,
        level    = as.character(.data[[v]])
      ) %>%
      select(variable, level, n,
             median_1, range_1,
             median_2, range_2,
             median_3, range_3)
    
    # apply desired level order to the summarised table
    if (!is.null(level_orders[[v]])) {
      df_sum <- df_sum %>% mutate(level = factor(level, levels = level_orders[[v]]))
    } else {
      df_sum <- df_sum %>% mutate(level = factor(level))
    }
    
    df_sum
  }) %>%
    mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = var_order)) %>%
    arrange(variable, level)
}

# run
vars <- var_order
dif_table <- median_time_order(vars, level_orders, data = data_6)
```

### Table 1.1 Supplement - Median, range and GLM delay symptom to treatment

```{r}
### desired level orders WITH the reference (or desired) first
level_orders <- list(
  age_group_2 = c("16-50", "0-1", "1-5", "6-15", ">50"),
  gender      = c("Female", "Male"),
  year_period = c("2007-2009", "2010-2014", "2015-2018", "2019-2023"),
  region      = c("Center-West", "North", "Northeast", "Southeast", "South"),
  education_level = c(
    "Incomplete elementary school",
    "Complete elementary and incomplete middle school",
    "Complete middle school and incomplete high school",
    "Complete high school",
    "Incomplete university",
    "Complete university",
    "N/A"
  ),
  race_2 = c("Brown", "White", "Afro-descendants", "Yellow", "Indigenous", "Unknown"),
  hiv_2  = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"),
  evolution = c("Cure", "Death for VL", "Death for any-cause", "Neglect", "Transferred", NA)
)
### Function to make the table 1 - Baseline characteristics based on delay treatment initiation
median_time_glm_ordered <- function(vars, level_orders = list(), data = data_6) {
  map_dfr(vars, function(v) {
    
    # subset: valid x and dif_day_tx_symp > 0 for log
    d_sub <- data %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[v]]),
             !is.na(dif_day_tx_symp),
             dif_day_tx_symp > 0) %>% 
      mutate(log_delay = log(dif_day_tx_symp))
    
    if (nrow(d_sub) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # enforce factor levels according to level_orders (this sets the reference)
    if (!is.null(level_orders[[v]])) {
      d_sub[[v]] <- factor(d_sub[[v]], levels = level_orders[[v]])
    } else {
      d_sub[[v]] <- factor(d_sub[[v]])
    }
    
    # summary: n, median, range
    df_sum <- d_sub %>%
      group_by(.data[[v]]) %>%
      summarise(
        n      = n(),
        median = paste0(round(median(dif_day_tx_symp, na.rm = TRUE), 0)," ", "[",
                        round(quantile(dif_day_tx_symp, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "-",
                        round(quantile(dif_day_tx_symp, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "]"),
        range  = paste0(min(dif_day_tx_symp, na.rm = TRUE), "-",
                        max(dif_day_tx_symp, na.rm = TRUE)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        variable = v,
        level    = as.character(.data[[v]])
      ) %>%
      select(variable, level, n, median, range)
    
    # GLM: log(dif_day_tx_symp) ~ v
    form <- as.formula(paste("log_delay ~", v))
    fit  <- glm(form, data = d_sub, family = gaussian())
    
    sm <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    coef_df <- as.data.frame(sm)
    coef_df$term <- rownames(coef_df)
    
    # reference = first level (given by level_orders)
    base_level <- levels(d_sub[[v]])[1]
    
    base_row <- data.frame(
      level    = base_level,
      gm_ratio = 1,
      gm_lower = 1,
      gm_upper = 1
    )
    
    others <- subset(coef_df, term != "(Intercept)")
    
    if (nrow(others) > 0) {
      others_df <- data.frame(
        level    = sub(paste0("^", v), "", others$term),
        gm_ratio = round(exp(others$Estimate), 3),
        gm_lower = round(exp(others$Estimate - 1.96 * others$`Std. Error`), 3),
        gm_upper = round(exp(others$Estimate + 1.96 * others$`Std. Error`), 3)
      )
      glm_tbl <- rbind(base_row, others_df)
    } else {
      glm_tbl <- base_row
 }
    
    # join summary + GLM CI
    df <- df_sum %>%
      left_join(glm_tbl, by = "level")
    
    # order levels for display too
    if (!is.null(level_orders[[v]])) {
      df <- df %>% mutate(level = factor(level, levels = level_orders[[v]]))
    } else {
      df <- df %>% mutate(level = factor(level))
    }
    
    df
  }) %>%
    mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = var_order)) %>%
    arrange(variable, level)
}

vars <- var_order

dif_table_glm <- median_time_glm_ordered(vars, level_orders, data = data_6)

dif_table_glm <- dif_table_glm %>% 
  mutate(
    is_ref = gm_ratio == 1 & gm_lower == 1 & gm_upper == 1,
    gm_ratio_chr = ifelse(is_ref, "Reference",
                          sprintf("%.2f", gm_ratio)),
    gm_lower_chr = ifelse(is_ref, "-",
                          sprintf("%.2f", gm_lower)),
    gm_upper_chr = ifelse(is_ref, "-",
                          sprintf("%.2f", gm_upper))
  ) %>% 
  mutate(gm_ratio_chr = paste0(gm_ratio_chr, " ", "[", gm_lower_chr,
                           "-", gm_upper_chr, "]")) %>% 
  select(-gm_lower_chr, -gm_upper_chr, -gm_lower, -gm_upper, 
         -is_ref, -gm_ratio) 

tab_1.1 <- dif_table_glm %>% 
  mutate(
    variable = recode(
      variable,
      age_group_2     = "Age group",
      gender          = "Gender",
      year_period     = "Period (year)",
      region          = "Region",
      education_level = "Education level",
      race_2          = "Race/colour",
      hiv_2           = "HIV status",
      name_tx         = "Treatment",
      evolution       = "Evolution"
    )
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    "Characteristic"          = variable,
    "Level"                   = level,
    "N"                       = n,
    "Median time (days)"      = median,
    "Range (days)"            = range,
    "GLM (geometric mean), [95% CI]"    = gm_ratio_chr
  ) %>% 
  flextable() %>% 
  merge_at(j = 1, i = 1:5,  part = "body") %>%  
  merge_at(j = 1, i = 6:7,  part = "body") %>% 
  merge_at(j = 1, i = 8:11, part = "body") %>% 
  merge_at(j = 1, i = 12:16,part = "body") %>% 
  merge_at(j = 1, i = 17:23,part = "body") %>% 
  merge_at(j = 1, i = 24:29,part = "body") %>% 
  merge_at(j = 1, i = 30:32,part = "body") %>% 
  merge_at(j = 1, i = 33:37,part = "body") %>% 
 # merge_at(j = 1, i = 38:42,part = "body") %>% 
  hline(i = c(5, 7, 11, 16, 23, 29, 32), part = "body", border = border_line) %>% 
  # center numeric / formatted columns
  align(j = 3:6, part = "body",   align = "center") %>% 
  align(j = 3:6, part = "header", align = "center") %>% 
  # bold characteristic column & header
  bold(j = 1, part = "all") %>% 
  bold(i = 1, part = "header") %>% 
  autofit()  

tab_1.1

tab_1.1 %>% 
  save_as_docx(path = here("figures and tables", "table_1.1.docx"))
```

```{r}
data_9 <- data_8 %>% 
    mutate_at(vars("fever", "edema", "weight_loss",
                   "cough_and_dyspnea", "spleen_enlargement",
                   "hemorrhagic_phenomena", "liver_enlargement",
                   "jaundice"), ~ if_else(. == 1, T, F))
  
  var_2 <- c("age_group_2", "gender",  "region", "race_2", 
                   "fever", "edema", "weight_loss",
                   "cough_and_dyspnea", "spleen_enlargement",
                   "hemorrhagic_phenomena", "liver_enlargement",
                   "jaundice", "hiv_2", "name_tx")
  
  symptom_vars <- c(
    "fever", "edema", "weight_loss",
    "cough_and_dyspnea", "spleen_enlargement",
    "hemorrhagic_phenomena", "liver_enlargement",
    "jaundice"
  )
  
  fmt_median_range <- function(x) {
    paste0(
      round(median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 0), " [",
      round(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "-",
      round(max(x, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "]"
    )
  }
  
  ### Function to make baseline table by delay variables
  median_time_order <- function(vars, data) {
    
    map_dfr(vars, function(v) {
      
      d_sub <- data %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(.data[[v]]),
          !is.na(dif_treat_outcome),
          dif_treat_outcome > 0
        )
      
      if (v %in% symptom_vars) {
        d_sub <- d_sub %>% filter(.data[[v]] == TRUE)
      }
      
      if (nrow(d_sub) == 0) return(NULL)
      
      # ====================
      # Alive / Death
      # ====================
      by_outcome <- d_sub %>%
        filter(!is.na(death_vl)) %>%
        group_by(
          variable = v,
          level = as.character(.data[[v]]),
          death_vl
        ) %>%
        summarise(
          stat = fmt_median_range(dif_treat_outcome),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          outcome = if_else(death_vl == 1, "Death", "Cure")
        ) %>%
        select(-death_vl)
      
      # ====================
      # Overall
      # ====================
      overall <- d_sub %>%
        group_by(variable = v,
          level = as.character(.data[[v]])) %>%
        summarise(
          stat = fmt_median_range(dif_treat_outcome),
          outcome = "Overall",
          .groups = "drop"
        )
      
      bind_rows(by_outcome, overall)
    }
    ) %>%
      
    pivot_wider(names_from = outcome,values_from = stat) %>%
      mutate( variable = factor(variable, levels = vars)) %>%
      arrange(variable, level)
  }
  
  # run
  dif_table <- median_time_order(var_2, data_9) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    mutate(
      variable = recode(
        variable,
        age_group_2 = "Age group",
        gender = "Gender",
        region = "Region",
        race_2 = "Race/colour",
        hiv_2 = "HIV status",
        name_tx = "Treatment",
        fever = "Fever",
        edema = "Oedema",
        weight_loss = "Weight loss",
        cough_and_dyspnea = "Cough and dyspnea",
        spleen_enlargement = "Splenomegaly",
        hemorrhagic_phenomena = "Haemorrhage",
        liver_enlargement = "Hepatomegaly",
        jaundice = "Jaundice"
      ),
      level = if_else(
        variable %in% c(
          "Fever", "Oedema", "Weight loss",
          "Cough and dyspnea", "Splenomegaly",
          "Haemorrhage", "Hepatomegaly", "Jaundice"
        ),
        variable,
        level
      )
    ) %>% 
    rename("Characteristic" = level) %>% 
    add_row(Characteristic = "Signs and Symptoms", 
            Cure = " ", Death = " ", Overall = " ", .before = 19)  
  
  t_sub <- function(x) {
    as_paragraph(as_i("t"), as_sub(x))
  }
  
  table_3 <-  as_grouped_data(dif_table, groups = "variable", expand_single = T) %>% 
    as_flextable(hide_grouplabel = T) %>% 
    delete_rows(i = c(23, 25, 27, 29, 31, 33, 35, 37, 39), part = "body") %>% 
    bold(i = c(1, 7, 10, 16, 23, 32, 35)) %>% 
    bold(i = 1, part = "header") %>% 
    align(j = c(2, 3, 4), part = "all", align = "center") %>%
    flextable:: compose(j = "Cure", part = "header",
      value = as_paragraph("Cure\nmedian [range] days (",
        as_i("t"), as_sub("t"), "–", as_i("t"), as_sub("c"), ")")
    ) %>% 
    flextable:: compose(j = "Cure", part = "header",
                        value = as_paragraph("Cure\nmedian [range] days (",
                                             as_i("t"), as_sub("t"), "–", as_i("t"), as_sub("c"), ")")
    ) %>% 
    flextable:: compose(j = "Death", part = "header",
                        value = as_paragraph("Death\nmedian [range] days (",
                                             as_i("t"), as_sub("t"), "–", as_i("t"), as_sub("m"), ")")
    ) %>% 
    flextable:: compose(j = "Overall", part = "header",
                        value = as_paragraph("Overall\nmedian [range] days (",
                                             as_i("t"), as_sub("t"), "–", as_i("t"), as_sub("o"), ")")
    ) %>% 
    footnote(
      i = 1,
      j = 2:4, part = "header",
      value = as_paragraph(
        "Time between treatment initiation (", as_i("t"), as_sub("t"),
        ") and outcome\n", as_i("t"), as_sub("c"),
        " = time to cure, ", as_i("t"), as_sub("m"),
        " = time to death, ", as_i("t"), as_sub("o"),
        " = time to outcome")
    ) %>% 
  autofit() 
    #theme_vanilla() %>% 
    
  table_3 %>% 
    save_as_docx(path = here("figures and tables", "table_3.docx"))
  
  table_3
```
